class.classification: same producer-state mutation/admission class, one object layer deeper
class.disposition: The native-enum compatibility repair does not close the original whole-property claim. Keep the fix and record the enum singleton mutation path as a bounded residual; do not mark B59 fully closed.

property.intended: An admitted producer state can be copied and branched without arbitrary callbacks, and producer-visible changes remain isolated and journaled.
property.implemented_gate: A static audit admits standard scalar-backed Enum/StrEnum members only when the metaclass, MRO, copy/reduction/attribute/scalar hooks, member storage, and exact scalar value pass. State admission depth follows the canonical state serialization envelope and tracked attachment path.
property.divergent_case: Enum members are process-local singletons. After admission, assigning Domain.fiscal._value_ = 'contested' changes both the base and branched typed model and leaves the mutation journal empty. The producer-state gate measures admission/copy callback shape; it does not enforce enum member immutability or reconcile this write.

observed_evidence.result: Before the repair, the maintained RunHierarchicalPolicySearchNode consumer failed at the policy_candidate_schema assignment because a real PolicyCandidateSchema contains native scalar-backed enums.
After the repair, both previously failing maintained producer and Stage-B refusal selectors pass.
A real hierarchical producer, typed PolicyCandidateSchema state, and _resolve_search_candidate consumer retain the model type, ProblemDomain enum, and candidate hash.
Independent local typed-model probe preserves enum/model identity, then shows private _value_ mutation changes both base and branch with zero journal operations.
Independent custody probe confirms the same alias-mutation path with a typed BaseModel held in params.
Before depth correction, the over-canonical-boundary graph was admitted while the corresponding canonical-boundary positive passed.
Five boundary tests pass: native typed enums, copy/reduction/attribute/mutable-value refusals, exact canonical depth edge, and live parent-path accounting.
The state-branching and producer-scope focused suite passed 98 tests; existing Pydantic and Torch warnings are retained in the full output.

G_options.mechanism: Keep typed enum identity and preserve only the static builtin-hook/scalar audit. Treat enum members as read-only atomic candidate inputs by declared producer convention.
G_options.compatibility: Preserves current PolicyCandidateSchema, Enum identity, serialization shape, and consumer behavior.
G_options.limitation: The runtime has no mechanism that makes standard Enum members read-only. Private _value_ or added-attribute writes remain unjournaled and can affect aliases. This option accepts a limited, candidate-grade assumption; it cannot support protected or published claims under the original B59 property.

G_options.mechanism: Introduce a closed enum projection at the producer boundary and an owner-controlled typed-consumer bridge that admits only a read-only representation, with schema-specific reconstruction where required.
G_options.compatibility: Requires a typed bridge and mutation semantics for PolicyCandidateSchema consumers. Reconstructing the current Enum class returns its shared singleton; a genuinely isolated read-only projection changes direct Enum identity/type behavior unless consumers are migrated.
G_options.required_verification: Real hierarchical producer -> projected persisted state -> _resolve_search_candidate and downstream simulation/output-bundle consumers; mutation of the projected member must refuse before state/cache publication; identity/equality/API impact must be explicit.

G_options.mechanism: Run each producer invocation in a separate process boundary and compare its before/after canonical typed-state projection with the journal before accepting output; reject or explicitly journal enum changes, and prevent a mutated singleton from contaminating another invocation.
G_options.compatibility: Can retain native typed Enum values inside each producer, but adds process startup/serialization cost and requires a parent-owned reconciliation bridge. A shared worker process is insufficient because enum singletons remain shared within it.
G_options.required_verification: Two sequential and concurrent invocations with one producer mutating _value_ must not affect the other/base state; changed typed projection must not silently bypass cache replay; actual results must reconcile with declared write paths.

smallest_missing_capability: An owner-enforced immutable enum value or a producer-result reconciliation boundary that detects state changes made through singleton member attributes. Current state_branching copy-on-write and mutation journaling have neither; deepcopy/copy of standard Enum members returns the same object.
decision_request: Choose whether native Enum values are accepted only under the explicitly limited read-only candidate profile, or whether the runtime must add an owner-enforced projection/process-reconciliation mechanism before the original producer-state custody claim can be restored.
current_disposition: Keep the compatibility and canonical-depth repairs. B59 remains limited/held for the original whole-property claim; do not describe admitted enum members as immutable, do not claim B59 fully closed, and do not widen scientific model/API types without the G decision.
